# Invites API and invite email

## What to build

Let any member of a team space invite people by email and let invitees accept or decline. This slice adds token columns to the existing `Invitation` table, DB helpers in a new `packages/db/src/space-invites.ts`, and oRPC procedures `spaces.members.list`, `spaces.invites.create`, `spaces.invites.cancel`, `spaces.invites.mine`, `spaces.invites.accept` and `spaces.invites.decline`. Creating an invite sends a transactional email with a link `<webOrigin>/invite/<token>`; signed-in users whose email matches see their pending invites through `spaces.invites.mine`. Accepting creates the `Member` and `SpaceMember` rows (role `member`). Everything is audited and rate-limited through Postgres. No UI in this slice (web and mobile screens are separate tasks); the contract below is what they will call.

## Team space model (already decided; do not change)

- A team space lives in its own `Organization` (the "team organization"), created with it. The org holds exactly one space in v1, so `Member` rows and `SpaceMember` rows of that org are the same people with the same role.
- `Space.kind` is `"private"` (default) or `"team"`. Team spaces are created with `isDefault: false`; the user's personal default space stays their default.
- Roles are `"owner"` and `"member"` on both `Member.role` and `SpaceMember.role`, kept equal.
- Members can invite, cancel invites, and create/edit/delete any bot, routine, credential or connection. Only owners remove members, change roles, and delete the space. Any member can manage the team plan and billing (audited).
- Everything in a team space is visible to every member. Personal data (voice, model preferences, AI-data consent, notification preferences, push tokens, devices, personal model credentials) stays per user.
- Private spaces have one member, so space scoping must behave exactly as before for them.


Already in the codebase from the previous slice: `Space.kind` (`"private" | "team"`), `createTeamSpace` in `packages/db/src/spaces.ts`, `spaces.createTeam` in `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` and `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts`, `kind`/`role` on `SpaceSchema`, and `spaces.list` listing spaces across organizations.

## Decisions baked in

- Invites only exist for `kind: "team"` spaces; inviting into a private space → `BAD_REQUEST`.
- Tokens: 32 random bytes, base64url; store only `sha256` hex in `Invitation.tokenHash` (unique). The raw token appears only in the email link and is never returned by any API.
- Expiry 7 days (`expiresAt = createdAt + 7d`). Expired invites are treated as closed everywhere (filtered by `expiresAt > now`), without a sweeper.
- Statuses: `pending`, `accepted`, `declined`, `cancelled`.
- Accept by token: signed-in user's email must equal the invite email (case-insensitive, trimmed). Possessing the token proves inbox access.
- Accept/decline by id (in-app, from `spaces.invites.mine`): email must match **and** `User.emailVerified` must be true.
- Sign-up policy does not change: an invite never lets someone sign up when registration is closed.
- Re-inviting an email with a pending invite cancels the old one and creates a new one (new token, new email). Emails that already belong to a member are skipped silently (not returned).
- Limits (checked inside the create transaction, counting `Invitation` rows): at most 10 emails per call (Zod), at most 50 pending unexpired invites per space, at most 20 invites created per inviter per hour. Exceeding → `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` with a short message.
- Audit actions: `space.member.invited`, `space.invite.cancelled`, `space.member.joined`, `space.invite.declined`. Never put the token or the email body in metadata; the email address goes in `target.label`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` lines 457-472 (`Invitation`: `id, organizationId, email, role?, status, expiresAt, createdAt, inviterId`), 339-353 (`Member`), 436-455 (`SpaceMember`, FK to `Member` via `(organizationId, userId)` so the `Member` row must be inserted first), 24-40 (`User.email`, `emailVerified`, `name`, `image`).
- `packages/db/src/spaces.ts` — `createSpaceDefaults` (creates memory doc + notification preference; a joining member needs only a `notificationPreference` row for `(spaceId, userId)`), transaction pattern in `createSpaceForMember`, `lockSpaceForContentCreation` (advisory lock on `hashtextextended(spaceId, 0)`; take the same lock when accepting so it serializes with space deletion), `SpaceDeletionInProgressError`.
- `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20260830200000_space_scope_names_and_user_credentials/migration.sql` lines 46-71 — trigger on `member` insert joins the org's default space only; team orgs have none, so create the `SpaceMember` row yourself.
- `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts` lines 35-47 (`asMemberOf`), 65-100 (handler + error mapping + audit), `spacesRoutes` return object (add `members` and `invites` nested objects under `spaces`). Do not add a second top-level `spaces` key in `router.ts`: put the handlers in a new module and spread them into the existing `spaces: { ... }` object.
- `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` lines 307-316 (`spaces` contract).
- `apps/api/src/router.ts` lines 59-141 (`RouterDeps`: `email?: TransactionalEmailProvider`, `onEmailError?`, `env.webOrigin` at 130).
- `apps/api/src/plugin-submissions.ts` lines 36-38 — fire-and-forget send:
  ```ts
  function sendLater({ email, onEmailError }: EmailDeps, message: Promise<TransactionalEmail>) {
    if (email) void message.then((built) => email.send(built)).catch((e) => onEmailError?.(e));
  }
  ```
- `packages/auth/src/referral-email.tsx` (whole file) and `packages/auth/src/email.tsx:19` (`message(to, subject, content, unsubscribeUrl?)`) — template pattern; exports at `packages/auth/src/index.ts:45,53-54`.
- `apps/api/src/referral-email.test.ts` lines 11-38 — offline email test with `{ send: vi.fn(async () => {}) } as unknown as TransactionalEmailProvider`.
- `packages/db/src/audit-events.ts` lines 19-72 — `recordAuditEvent`.
- `apps/api/src/space-availability.postgres.test.ts` lines 46-79 — fixtures with several users and `member` rows.

## Patterns to follow

**Contract additions (`packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`, inside `spaces`):**
```ts
members: {
  list: oc.input(z.object({ spaceId: Id })).output(SpaceMembersSchema),
},
invites: {
  create: oc.input(z.object({ spaceId: Id, emails: z.array(z.string().trim().toLowerCase().email()).min(1).max(10) }))
    .output(z.object({ invites: z.array(SpaceInviteSchema) })),
  cancel: oc.input(z.object({ inviteId: Id })).output(z.object({})),
  mine: oc.output(z.array(IncomingSpaceInviteSchema)),
  accept: oc.input(z.union([z.object({ token: z.string().min(20).max(200) }), z.object({ inviteId: Id })])).output(z.object({ spaceId: Id })),
  decline: oc.input(z.union([z.object({ token: z.string().min(20).max(200) }), z.object({ inviteId: Id })])).output(z.object({})),
},
```
**Schemas (new file `packages/contracts/src/space-members.ts`, exported from `packages/contracts/src/index.ts`):**
```ts
export const SpaceRoleSchema = z.enum(["owner", "member"]);
export const SpaceMemberSchema = z.object({ userId: Id, name: z.string(), email: z.string(), image: z.string().nullable(), role: SpaceRoleSchema, joinedAt: z.string() });
export const SpaceInviteSchema = z.object({ id: Id, email: z.string(), expiresAt: z.string(), invitedBy: z.object({ userId: Id, name: z.string() }) });
export const SpaceMembersSchema = z.object({ members: z.array(SpaceMemberSchema), invites: z.array(SpaceInviteSchema) });
export const IncomingSpaceInviteSchema = z.object({ id: Id, spaceId: Id, spaceName: z.string(), invitedByName: z.string(), expiresAt: z.string() });
```
`role` on `SpaceSchema` from the previous slice should reuse `SpaceRoleSchema` if convenient.

**Errors:** add classes in `space-invites.ts` (`InviteNotFoundError` → `NOT_FOUND`, `InviteEmailMismatchError` → `FORBIDDEN`, `InviteLimitError` → `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`, `NotTeamSpaceError` → `BAD_REQUEST`). An unknown, used, expired or cancelled token is `NOT_FOUND` (never reveal which).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261111130000_space_invitations/migration.sql`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `-- Additive: older releases never read these columns.` then `ALTER TABLE "invitation" ADD COLUMN "spaceId" TEXT, ADD COLUMN "tokenHash" TEXT, ADD COLUMN "respondedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);` `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "invitation_tokenHash_key" ON "invitation"("tokenHash");` `CREATE INDEX "invitation_spaceId_status_idx" ON "invitation"("spaceId", "status");` `CREATE INDEX "invitation_inviterId_createdAt_idx" ON "invitation"("inviterId", "createdAt");` Add FK `spaceId` → `spaces(id)` ON DELETE CASCADE.

### UPDATE `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma`

- **IMPLEMENT**: on `Invitation` add `spaceId String?`, `space Space? @relation(fields: [spaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)`, `tokenHash String? @unique`, `respondedAt DateTime?`, `@@index([spaceId, status])`, `@@index([inviterId, createdAt])`; add `invitations Invitation[]` on `Space`.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm db:generate`

### CREATE `packages/db/src/space-invites.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `listSpaceMembers(prisma, { spaceId })` → members (join `spaceMember` → `member.user` for name/email/image, ordered by `createdAt`) and pending unexpired invites with inviter name.
  - `createSpaceInvites(prisma, { spaceId, inviterId, emails, now })` → Serializable tx: assert inviter is a `spaceMember` of a `kind: "team"` space not `deletingAt`; enforce limits; skip emails of existing members (compare lowercased `user.email`); cancel existing pending invite for the same `(spaceId, email)`; create `Invitation` rows `{ id: randomUUID(), organizationId, spaceId, email, role: "member", status: "pending", expiresAt, inviterId, tokenHash }`; return `[{ invite, token }]` (token only returned to the caller in the API process for the email).
  - `cancelSpaceInvite(prisma, { inviteId, userId })` → caller must be a member of the invite's space; sets `status: "cancelled"`, `respondedAt`.
  - `listIncomingInvites(prisma, { email })` → pending unexpired invites for that email with space name and inviter name.
  - `acceptSpaceInvite(prisma, { userId, email, emailVerified, token? | inviteId? })` → Serializable tx: take the space advisory lock (`pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(spaceId, 0))`), find the pending unexpired invite, check email (and `emailVerified` for id path), reject if space `deletingAt`; insert `member` `{ id: randomUUID(), organizationId, userId, role: "member", createdAt }` (if a member row already exists, treat as already joined and just close the invite), insert `spaceMember` `{ id: randomUUID(), spaceId, organizationId, userId, role: "member", createdAt }`, insert `notificationPreference` `{ spaceId, userId }`; set invite `accepted`/`respondedAt`; return `{ spaceId, organizationId }`.
  - `declineSpaceInvite(...)` → same lookup rules; `status: "declined"`.
  - `hashInviteToken(token)` → `createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex")`; `newInviteToken()` → `randomBytes(32).toString("base64url")`.
- **GOTCHA**: these tables have no row-level security, but call them inside `runAsSystem("<reason>", ...)` from the API like `spaces.create` does.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db check`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/index.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: export the new functions and error classes.

### CREATE `packages/auth/src/space-invite-email.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT** `spaceInviteEmail({ to, inviterName, spaceName, acceptUrl }): Promise<TransactionalEmail>` using `message(to, \`${inviterName} invited you to ${spaceName}\`, <>...</>)` with no unsubscribe URL (transactional). Body: one sentence naming inviter and space, a `Link` "Join <spaceName>" to `acceptUrl`, and "This invite expires in 7 days." Use `displayName` for names. Export from `packages/auth/src/index.ts`.

### CREATE `apps/api/src/routes/space-members.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** `spaceMemberRoutes(ctx)` returning `{ members: { list }, invites: { create, cancel, mine, accept, decline } }` handlers; spread into the `spaces` object in `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts` (`spaces: { list, create, ..., ...spaceMemberRoutes(ctx) }`).
  - `members.list` / `invites.create`: membership of `input.spaceId` checked via `asMemberOf`-style lookup (export `asMemberOf` from `routes/spaces.ts` or move it to a shared helper), then `runAsSystem`.
  - `invites.create`: after commit, for each `{ invite, token }` call `sendLater(deps, spaceInviteEmail({ to: invite.email, inviterName, spaceName, acceptUrl: new URL(\`/invite/${token}\`, deps.env.webOrigin).toString() }))`; record `space.member.invited` per invite; return invites without tokens.
  - `invites.mine`: reads the actor's user row (email) and returns `listIncomingInvites`.
  - `invites.accept`/`decline`: load the actor's `user` (`email`, `emailVerified`); map errors; audit `space.member.joined` (spaceId, target user) or `space.invite.declined`.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### CREATE `apps/api/src/space-invites.postgres.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** with a fake email provider `{ send: vi.fn(async () => {}) }` in `RouterDeps.email` and `env.webOrigin: "http://127.0.0.1:5173"`. Cases: create sends one email whose `text`/`html` contains `/invite/`; extract the token from the sent email and accept as a second user with the same email → member appears in `members.list` with role `member`, `spaceMember` exists, `spaces.list` for the invitee includes the team space; wrong email → `FORBIDDEN`; expired (set `expiresAt` in the past) → `NOT_FOUND`; reuse of an accepted token → `NOT_FOUND`; cancel then accept → `NOT_FOUND`; decline → status `declined`; accept by id with `emailVerified: false` → `FORBIDDEN`, with `true` → ok; non-member calling `members.list`/`invites.create` → `NOT_FOUND`; inviting into a private space → `BAD_REQUEST`; 21st invite in an hour by the same inviter → `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`; existing members are skipped; `invites.mine` lists only the caller's pending invites; audit rows written for invited/joined.

### CREATE `packages/auth/src/space-invite-email.test.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: renders and asserts `to`, subject contains the space name, body contains the accept URL and has no unsubscribe header.

### UPDATE `docs/self-host-audit-log.md`

- **IMPLEMENT**: add the four new action names to the table.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `spaces.invites.create { spaceId, emails: ["teammate@rakazo.test"] }` → `{ invites: [{ id, email, expiresAt, invitedBy }] }` and one email with an `/invite/<token>` link.
- [ ] `spaces.invites.accept { token }` by a user with that email → `{ spaceId }`; `Member` + `SpaceMember` rows exist; invite `accepted`.
- [ ] Tokens are single-use, expire after 7 days, are bound to the email, and are stored only as hashes.
- [ ] `spaces.members.list` returns members and pending invites; non-members get `NOT_FOUND`.
- [ ] Limits enforced with `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`; private spaces refuse invites.
- [ ] Audit events written; no token in any audit row or log.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/src apps/api/src/routes
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=space-invites
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
